title: Daily run 2026-11-16 (exact Nov 10-15; hourly to Nov 15 22h)

sections.h: NEW check - share of key traffic (should be <2% unless volumetric)
items: Each combination x key is now checked against the key's TOTAL traffic (all Production sessions, 04_key_totals.sql). >2% of the key's traffic = FP risk, unless the key's traffic jumped >=1.5x that day and the flagged sessions explain >=50% of the jump (volumetric attack). Baseline uses the median day. Results: 60 FP-risk key/combination pairs, 2 volumetric, 114 OK (window Nov 12-15). Most FP-risk pairs are <10% verified, i.e. already blocked bot traffic on high-bot keys.

Review before adding pressure (FP risk AND >=30% of flagged sessions verify): Adobe Sign-in os-spoof+pagebio 1.4% avg / 2.2% peak at 93% verified; Amazon Client os-spoof+pagebio 4.8% at 89% verified (flags ~5% of normal traffic every day); Roblox Game Join spoofed-OS+pagebio+grease 16.7% avg / 27% peak at 34% verified, plus ends-cl, pagebio, pragma at 37-44% verified; Uber Account Mgmt ends-cl 17.6% avg / 38% peak at 36% and appleos 3.4% / 7.5% peak at 38%; gtop100 dishort300+dp-spoof+ja4 1.6% / 5.4% peak at 44%.

Standing high footprint (flags >2% of the key's median normal day): Highlight AI ends-cl 86% of all traffic (0% verified - the key is mostly bot), Amazon IDS spoofed-OS+pagebio+grease 9.4% and os-spoof+pagebio 5.2%, Customer Dashboard Demo Data rta 7.9%, Roblox Game Join ends-te 5.1%, Amazon Client os-spoof+pagebio 4.7% at 89% verified (most likely real FPs), MS Identity Signup webgl 4.3%, Bumble SMS pagebio 3.4%.

Candidates: g-spoofed-os-mismatch-high-risk-sig-st stays under 2% on every key except Roblox Signup (2.0% peak); g-high-risk-sig-lt-ip-intel-medium-pagebio-null peaks 2.1-9.9%; g-high-risk-sig-lt-di-short-300-pxr1 peaks 4.6-9.1%.

Uber Account Management (Key 2): ends-cl / ct-before-cl combos 1.86M (Nov 10, 57% verified), 1.83M (Nov 11, 35%), 817k (Nov 12, 37%); hourly peaks Nov 10 16-18h (~1.8M, mostly verified) and Nov 11 11-13h. Plus appleos 162k on Nov 12 at 38%. Back to ~20k/day since Nov 13.
Adobe ARP FF (Key 8): the Nov 9 wave peaked at 888k on Nov 10 (91% verified) and 346k on Nov 11 (74%), then fell to ~80k/day at 4-13% verified from Nov 12 - looks mitigated.

Uber SMS (Key 1): ends-cl combo 23.0M on Nov 11 at 0% verified (blocked); spoofed-OS family 250k on Nov 12 at 54% verified, back to ~85-100k/day at 13-21% since. single-click + dp-spoof 62k on Nov 13 at 83% verified.

Amazon IDS spoofed-OS family ~155k/day (5%); Microsoft Identity Signup webgl ~110k/day (0%); Adobe Commerce OS-spoofing ~20k/day (0%); gtop100 webgl ~38k/day (5%); Highlight AI ends-cl fell from ~85k to 4k/day (0%).

DI dictionary revert partly landed Nov 12 22:09-22:54 UTC (m.davies, THR-408..413): dict-1 and dict-neg1 fire again with new thresholds (>1.999 / 3.999 / 9.999) and BofA Workforce ATM excluded. dict-3 (THR-405..407) is STILL == -99, so the CHNGE-6738 parent C and its 6 key-level TTs still cannot fire; hold on didict3_dishort300 stays.

g-device-parameter-spoofing includes dict-1/neg1, so every *_dp_spoof combo changed definition from Nov 13. Rises there after Nov 12 (e.g. gtop100 dishort300+dp-spoof+ja4 83k on Nov 15 at 44%, Amazon IDS single-click 1% -> 23-25% verified, Roblox Signup / MS Signup ends-te) may be the revert, not new attacks. Excluded from discovery until Nov 24.
57 CHNGE-6738 key-level telltales created Nov 10 (validated: all correct, no pressure yet).
